intent: Teach landscape-change order, wide harbour views, snow remaining on the highest peak, across-versus-down slope instructions, spring as a stream source, thin surface ice and water-depth warnings.
picturePurpose: Four reversible range/position/route/layer diagrams, two exact evidence tasks and one event-order task; no invented geography, measurements, causal timing or completed instructions.

workshop.title: 山景、路线与表面
workshop.instruction: 排出变化先后，改变所见范围和路线，再核对原句证据。

transfer.stem: 先后、视野和冰层厚薄都改了，哪组英文全保留？
transfer.passage:
三条新信息
下雨前，景观已经变绿。从塔上看到的港口景色范围很窄。厚厚一层冰覆盖了表面。
词语提示：narrow 狭窄的；thick 厚的。

options.text: The landscape turned green before the rain. The tower gives a narrow view of the harbour. A thick layer of ice covered the surface.
The landscape turned green after the rain. The tower gives a narrow view of the harbour. A thick layer of ice covered the surface.
The landscape turned green before the rain. The tower gives a wide view of the harbour. A thick layer of ice covered the surface.
The landscape turned green before the rain. The tower gives a narrow view of the harbour. A thin layer of ice covered the surface.

answer.display: The landscape turned green before the rain. The tower gives a narrow view of the harbour. A thick layer of ice covered the surface.

explanation.strategy: 分别核对变绿先后、视野宽窄和冰层厚薄。

steps.text: 下雨前变绿：turned green before the rain。
steps.reason: before是之前，不能沿用旧句after之后。

steps.text: 视野窄：a narrow view of the harbour。
steps.reason: narrow改变范围，所见景物仍是港口。

steps.text: 厚冰覆盖表面：A thick layer of ice covered the surface。
steps.reason: thick是厚；没有说内部全冻住，也不推断承重。

explanation.pitfall: 不要沿用原句里的after、wide和thin；每个新条件都要重新核对。

visual.title: 逐项换新条件
visual.caption: 原句没有给天数、视角、冰层厚度或承重；新题也不补这些数值。

explanation.transfer: 把before、narrow、thick各换成相反条件，哪条信息随之改变？
